input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for global exception handler, animal, bird. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Candidate, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Candidate, I want to browse job listings and receive personalized recommendations, so that I can find relevant career opportunities.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with logger functionality, so that I can accomplish my logger-related tasks.
